Job Solution.question: ৮) 'কাজলকালো' কোন সমাস?
Job Solution.exp:

Job Solution.question: ৯) নিচের কোনটি রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুরের রচনা?

Every opposition candidate except she was defeated in the election.

Job Solution.question: ২৭) The poor boy <u>was denied treatment because of his parents couldn’t pay upfront</u>.
Job Solution.option1: ক) Was denied treatment because of his parents couldn’t pay upfront
Job Solution.option2: খ) is denied treatment because of his parents couldn’t pay upfront
Job Solution.option3: গ) was denied treatment because his parents couldn’t pay upfront
Job Solution.option4: ঘ) has denied treatment because his parents couldn’t pay upfront
Job Solution.option5: ঙ) have denied treatment because his parents couldn’t pay upfront
Job Solution.exp: ''Because of'' and ''because are'' both are used to introduce reasons. Because of is a preposition, it is generally followed by a verb+ing or a noun. Because is a conjunction, it is followed by a subject and a verb. So, the correct answer will be option (c).

Job Solution.question: ৩৬) Kalam has three daughters; Shaila, Meena and Tina. Three years ago, when Kalam was twice as old as Tina, he was 30 years older than Meena. Now he is 47 years older than Shaila. In 4 years, Shaila will be half as old as Tina. What is the sum of the current ages of Kalam and his three daughters?
Job Solution.exp:
Suppose, three years ago Tina's Age was = x years
So, then Kalam's age was = 2x years, Meena's age was = 2x-30.
Now Kalam's age = 2x+3, Shaila's age = 2x+3 - 47 = 2x-44.
According to the question,
x+7 = 2(2x-44+4)
⇒ x+7 = 4x-80
⇒ 3x = 87
⇒ x = 29
current age of Kalam = 2x+3 = 2×29 + 3 = 61, Tina = 29+3 = 32,
Meena = 61-30 = 31, Shaila = 2×29 - 44 = 14.
Sum of their ages = 61+32+31+14 = 138.

Job Solution.question: ৪৭) Anik travels 35 kilometers (km) partly at 4km /h and partly at 5 km/h. If he covers the distance at 5 km/h he could cover 2 km more in the same time. The time taken to cover the whole distance at original rate is-
Job Solution.exp:
Suppose, he traveled at 4 km/h for p hours and @5 km/h for q hours.
So, 4p+5q = 35 -------- (i)
According to the question,
5(p+q) = 35+2
⇒ 5p + 5q = 37 -------- (ii)
Solving these two equations, we get,
p = 2, q = 27/5
So, total time taken = 2 + 27/5 = 37/5 hr = 7hr + 2×60/5 min = 7 hr 24 min.

Job Solution.question: ৫০) a<sup>2</sup> is divisible by both 40 and 75 if a has exactly three distinct prime factors, which of the following could be the value of 'a'?
Job Solution.exp:
LCM of 40 and 75 = 600.
600 = 2² × 5² × 3 × 2.
As a² is a perfect square number,
the least value of a² is = 2²×5² × 3²×2² = 3600.
So, the value of a = √3600 = 60.

Job Solution.question: ৫১) There are 48 books on 3 shelves. If 3 books from third shelf are shifted to the second there will be same number of books on first and third shelves and double the number of books on second shelf. How many books were there on three shelves originally?
Job Solution.exp:
Suppose, the first shelf had x books.
So, the third shelf had x+3 books.
And the second shelf had 2x-3 books.
According to the question,
x + x+3 + 2x-3 = 48
4x = 48
x = 12
1st shelf = 12, 2nd shelf = 2×12-3 = 21, 3rd shelf = 12+3 = 15.

Job Solution.question: ৫২) Arafat has TK. 420. He purchased fifty mangoes and thirty oranges with the whole amount. He then chose to return six mangoes for nine oranges as both quantities are equally priced. What is the price of each Mango in Tk?
Job Solution.exp:
Price of 6 mangoes = Price of 9 oranges
⇒ (Price of 1 mango) : (Price of 1 orange) = 9/6 = 3 : 2
Suppose, the price of each mango is Tk. 3x, and the price of each orange is Tk. 2x.
According to the question,
50×3x + 30×2x = 420
⇒ x = 2
Price of each mango = 3×2 = Tk. 6.

বাংলাদেশে প্রথম জিআই পণ্য হিসেবে ২০১৬ সালে জামদানি শাড়ি, দ্বিতীয় জিআই পণ্য হিসেবে ২০১৭ সালে ইলিশ এবং সর্বশেষ ২০১৯ সালে ক্ষীরসাপাত বা হিমসাগর আম স্বীকৃতি পায়।
Source: dpdt.gov.bd

Job Solution.question: ৬৯) Which of the following is the largest ethnic group in Bangladesh?
Job Solution.exp:
বাংলাদেশে বসবাসকারী ৫০টি ক্ষুদ্র নৃ-গোষ্ঠীর মধ্যে বৃহত্তম নৃ-গোষ্ঠীর নাম চাকমা। দ্বিতীয় সংখ্যাগরিষ্ঠ ক্ষুদ্র নৃ-গোষ্ঠীর নাম সাঁওতাল। রাজশাহী রংপুর-দিনাজপুর অঞ্চলে বসবাস রয়েছে।
উৎসঃ বাংলাপিডিয়া

Job Solution.question: ৭০) Which of the following countries has joined as the 19th EU member country in the club of countries that use the euro currency?
Job Solution.exp:
Lithuania has joined as the 19th EU member country in the club of countries that use the euro currency.
Source: europa.eu

Job Solution.question: ৭১) The NAFTA Comprises North America, Canada and-
Job Solution.exp:
The North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) is a treaty entered into by the United States, Canada, and Mexico; it went into effect on January 1, 1994.
Source:inc.com

Job Solution.question: ৭২) Which country hosted the ‘BIMSTEC SUMMIT 2018’?
Job Solution.exp:
The Fourth BIMSTEC Summit was held in Kathmandu, Nepal on 30-31 August 2018.
Source: BIMSTEC

Job Solution.question: ৭৩) Which of the following is the second highest award for individual gallantry in Bangladesh?
Job Solution.exp:
বাংলাদেশের স্বাধীনতা যুদ্ধে যাঁরা অবদান রেখেছিলেন তাদের মধ্যে থেকে বাংলাদেশ সরকার বিভিন্ন জনকে তাদের অবদানের ভিত্তিতে বীরশ্রেষ্ঠ, বীরউত্তম, বীরবিক্রম ও বীরপ্রতীক উপাধিতে ভূষিত করেন। বীর উত্তম বাংলাদেশের দ্বিতীয় সর্বোচ্চ বীরত্বের পুরস্কার।
Source: bgb.gov.bd

Job Solution.question: ৭৪) To migrate from a least developed country to a developing country Gross National Income per capita of a country has to be ____ dollar.
Job Solution.exp:
To migrate from a least developed country to a developing country Gross National Income per capita of a country has to be 1230 dollar.
Source: unctad.org

Job Solution.question: ৭৫) Which article of the constitution Bangladesh establishes the fundamental rights to education for all?
Job Solution.exp:
17th article of the constitution Bangladesh establishes the fundamental rights to free and compulsory education for all.
Source: Constitution of Bangladesh
